**Benchmark performance:**
```
BenchmarkHashMap_Put-16     4,035,932   320.1 ns/op   98 B/op   6 allocs/op
BenchmarkHashMap_Get-16    20,131,334    59.5 ns/op   15 B/op   1 allocs/op
```

**Edge cases covered by the 9 E2E tests:**

| Test | Edge Case |
|------|-----------|
| TickBased | Mutation sequencing, Tick correctness, no-ops (failed delete) |
| Growth | Automatic resize up to 1000 entries, data integrity after resize |
| DeletionAndReinsertion | Delete + reinsert same key with new value |
| Collision | All keys forced into 4 buckets (separate chaining under load) |
| NegativeKeys | `int` keys `-1`, `-2`, `0`, `1` — hash distribution for negatives |
| EmptyMap | All operations on fresh map: Get, Delete, Keys, Values, Entries, Tick |
| UpdateTicksLoadFactor | Put update doesn't change size or load factor |
| KeysValuesEntries | Collection views return correct cardinality and values |
| InterfaceType | Struct keys (`point{X, Y int}`) — comparable composite keys |
